events.headline: US-Iran/Israel war remains active: Strait of Hormuz contested, US naval blockade of Iranian oil ports continues, Ukraine drone/air strikes at war-highs
Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey signed the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, a mutual-defense pact reshaping Middle East security architecture
Crude oil trading near $101/bbl, holding an elevated geopolitical risk premium tied to the contested Strait of Hormuz and ongoing US blockade of Iran
Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate 25bp to 3.75%-4% on Sept 16 (first hike since 2023) to fight inflation, with markets pricing another hike this year
China's rare-earth, lithium-battery and critical-minerals export controls remain suspended under the US-China trade truce (through Nov 10, 2026), easing near-term supply-crunch fears
AI data-center buildout continues to strain chip supply; hyperscalers (Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon) shifting spend toward inference/custom ASICs, supporting semiconductor demand and pricing
US lawmakers are escalating AI antitrust/regulatory scrutiny, including a proposed federal-charter regime for large AI firms, a headwind for big-tech/AI valuations
